notes.title: Release notes - The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - 2.32.378.9106
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:


 - Issue with dialogue not being in the correct state after Resetting the game, causing softocks
 - Issue using the Click to Start Menu Issue with a controller
 - Loading Screen Music only playing for a brief second when exiting a Case
 - Various Dialogue Choices and Menu issues
 - Case 4: Ticket Booth Translation Issues
 - Restarting a Case while Dialogue is on Screen making Dialogue Choices unable to be interacted with
 - Item Hotspots overlapping inventory causing the wrong item to be picked up on smaller screens 
 - Case 6: Cables Hotspot disappearring after picking one up
 - Case 6: Save/Load making the Science Bench Hotspot layer over Mcking's hotspot
 - Case 4: Save/Load causing McQueen's hotspot to reappear at his previously position
 - Hotspot text not layering above items when dragging them
 - Case 2: No Door SFX when entering and leaving Nanny Dooley's Room 
 - Raxa Case: Save/Load makeing Raxa's reflection disappear in the first WWW Screen
 - Strange issue with Main Interaction Button if it's not mapped
 - Inventory items missing

notes.title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Nintendo Switch / PS5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey detectives, 

We have released a patch for Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark that fixed some hotspot inconsistencies and placements which could interfere with the players’ inventory, fixed an issue with some achievements not firing, and more. You can read the full patch notes below.

Patch Notes

 Fixed an issue with some achievements not firing
 Fixed some hotspots inconsistencies and placements which could interfere with the players’ inventory
 Fixed some dialogue errors and typos
 Fixed some visual and sfx glitches which would appear after a save/load
 Fixed an issue where resetting the game caused the Power Button to show in the the Main Menu on Consoles
 Optimisation and improvements to performance and load times
 Fixed some gameplay blockers where players where unable to progress past certain screens
 Fixed issues with remapping controls
 Added some missing localisation
 Fixed issue with the Face Buttons not showing on the PlayStation How to Play Screen
 Fixed issues with Restarting a Case taking you to the wrong Case
 Fixed issues with dialogue Choices not saving
 Fixed other issues with starting the game from a fresh Save
 Fixed the slower cursor slower in Case 9
 Fixed not being able to use the Pause Menu in the Christmas Case
 Minor bug fixes


- Riv Otter
